article.story: Central Arkansas Bears (2-1) at Arkansas Razorbacks (2-1) Fayetteville, Arkansas; Friday, 8 p.m. EST LINE: Razorbacks -25.5; over/under is 160.5 BOTTOM LINE: No. 19 Arkansas takes on Central Arkansas in out-of-conference action. Arkansas went 28-9 overall with a 16-1 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Razorbacks averaged 14.8 points off of turnovers, 13.9 second-chance points and 25.8 bench points last season. Central Arkansas went 22-12 overall last season while going 6-10 on the road. The Bears averaged 80.9 points per game while allowing opponents to score 74.7 last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
